name: Camping beim Fischer
beschreibung: Camping beim Fischer is located in Münsing and operates as a year-round campsite. The grounds offer partly parcelled pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The sanitary facilities are regularly cleaned and include showers and toilets in separate cubicles. A small kiosk on site provides guests with fresh bread rolls and basic groceries. The adjacent forest is ideal for short strolls, and cycle paths are directly accessible. Water sports facilities are available at the nearby lake, whose shore is within easy walking distance of the site. A communal barbecue area is also available.
